title: Potential along a line of two charges
caption: Drag the probe and read V off the curve. The field is the slope, not the height.

title: Charge released on the axis of a ring
caption: An electron dropped onto the axis of a positive ring. Watch it fall into the centre and overshoot.

title: Equipotentials and field lines
caption: Field lines cross equipotentials at right angles. Where the rings crowd, the field is strong.
